'''Tatsuhisa Suzuki''' (Japanese: '''鈴木達央''' ''Suzuki Tatsuhisa'') is a Japanese voice actor for {{aniseries|PTS}}. His most notable role is {{Ash}}'s [[rival]] {{an|Barry}}.

==Biography==
Suzuki was born on November 11, 1983 in Ichikawa, Chiba, Japan, but he grew up in Okazaki, Aichi, Japan. He attended Japan Narration and Acting School, and joined {{wp|I'm Enterprise}} before graduating. His performance of an image song for the anime series {{wp|Saint Beast}} got him noticed by music director Kenichirō Tsutsumi from {{wp|Lantis}} who invited him to become a singer. A few years later, his label approached him about forming a band, and OLDCODEX was formed in 2009 after a search for potential members. Suzuki serves as the band's frontman and vocalist.

Suzuki also hosts or has hosted several radio shows including:
* ''Mobile Cultural Broadcast A&G Suzuki Tatsuhisa Radio TIME.'' (モバイル文化放送A&G 鈴木達央ラジオTIME.)
* ''Dengeki Taishou'' (電撃大賞)
* ''Shuuei Academy Maiden Research Institute'' (集英学園乙女研究部)
* ''BLOOD-R''
